Drivers will be able to turn onto the new portion of Williams Road from U.S. 70 and Old Cherry Point Road. At the new intersection of Williams Road and Old Cherry Point Road, traffic on Williams Road will flow through continuously onto Old Cherry Point Road without stopping.
